resources.string: Acceleration is an acceleration limiter that tames edge but leaves brightness.
Acceleration2 is Acceleration, only better: updated for high sample rates and a more extreme effect.
ADClip7 is the original Airwindows loudness maximizer and peak control.
ADClip8 is a stacked-up Airwindows loudness maximizer based on ClipOnly2.
ADClip9 is the ClipOnly3 version of a loudness and size maximizer.
ADT is a double short delay tap with saturation.
Air is a bright EQ unlike any other. Designed for 44.1 kHz.
Air2 is a different bright EQ with a silky tone and high sample rate support.
Air3 creates a new form of air-band EQ based on Kalman filtering.
Air4 extends Air3 with controllable high-frequency limiting.
AngleEQ is a strange and colorful EQ.
AngleFilter is the synth-style extension of AngleEQ.
Apicolypse is a re-release of the old API-style color adder, exactly as it was.
AQuickVoiceClip softens headset mic recordings that were clipped very hard during capture.
AtmosphereBuss is Console5 processing with powerful new acoustic distance effects.
AtmosphereChannel is Console5 processing with powerful new acoustic distance effects.
Aura is a new kind of resonant lowpass EQ.
AutoPan adds organic stereo movement to your mix.
Average is a distinctive sort of lowpass filter.
AverMatrix turns averaging into a full-featured EQ.
Balanced lets you run an XLR input into a stereo input, sum it to mono and use it.
BassAmp is an old plugin with new tweaks that gives you bass guitar tones.
BassDrive is an old secret weapon, a kind of bass amp.
BassKit is centered bass reinforcement with sub fill. Clean and controllable.
Baxandall is an excellent general-purpose EQ.
Baxandall2 is Baxandall, extended and made more powerful.
Baxandall3 is for new tone colors.
BezEQ is a strange, alien three-band shelving EQ.
BezEQ2 is a unique, subtle three-band shelving EQ.
BezEQ3 refines the concept into four vivid, unified bands.
BeziComp is a radical compressor that eliminates aliasing.
BigAmp is a very flexible amp-like thing with a taste for the bizarre.
Biquad is the Airwindows implementation of a biquad filter.
Biquad2 is the Airwindows biquad filter that is more sweepable and synth-like.
BiquadDouble is a handy cascaded biquad filter: steeper roll-off before resonance.
BiquadHiLo is the highpass and lowpass filter from ConsoleX.
BiquadNonLin is Capacitor2, but for biquad filtering.
BiquadOneHalf is an interleaved biquad filter like Biquad.
BiquadPlus is Biquad plus zipper noise suppression, for moving the controls.
BiquadStack makes a parametric EQ out of stacked biquad filters.
BiquadTriple is a handy cascaded biquad filter: steeper roll-off before resonance.
BitDualPan is a dual pan that is almost BitShiftGain.
Bite is an unusual edge maker.
BitGlitter is a digital lo-fi plugin in the style of old samplers.
BitShiftGain is the \"one weird trick\" perfect boost or cut, but only in 6 dB steps.
BitShiftPan gives you gain and pan controls that work only with bit shifts.
BlockParty is like a moderately saturated analog limiter.
BrassRider is a \"one weird trick\" for drum overheads in metal.
BrightAmbience is for very bright gated reverbs.
BrightAmbience2 is more BrightAmbience, with better tone and more slapback effects.
BrightAmbience3 adds undersampling for high sample rates and better feedback.
BussColors4 is the Airwindows console emulations, now working correctly up to 192 kHz.
ButterComp is the softest, smoothest Airwindows compressor.
ButterComp2 is an improved ButterComp with an output control and sound upgrades.
C5RawBuss is the original Console5 algorithm, with optional very gentle DC suppression.
C5RawChannel is the original Console5 algorithm, with optional very gentle DC suppression.
Cabs is an Airwindows guitar speaker cabinet simulator.
Cabs2 uses very phasey filters to simulate a speaker cabinet.
Calibre is a re-release of another old Character plugin.
Cans is a room simulator for mixing on headphones.
CansAW puts Chris\'s Airwindows room into a plugin, for mixing on headphones.
Capacitor is a new type of lowpass and highpass filter.
Capacitor2 is Capacitor with extra analog modeling and mojo.
Chamber is a feedforward reverb based on the golden ratio.
Chamber2 is a feedforward reverb, a blur delay and a glitch topping in one.
Channel4 is a tone coloring plugin that gives more of an analog feel.
Channel5 is Channel for 2018, with new subtleties.
Channel6 uses the Spiral algorithm.
Channel7 improves slew clipping and lets you blend Channel6 and Channel5.
Channel8 is Channel7 with updates from Capacitor2 and Slew3: more and better of what Channel is.
Channel9 is Channel8 with ultrasonic filtering and new Teac and Mackie low-end settings.
ChannelX turns Channel9 into a profusion of wild experiments.
ChimeyDeluxe is a very flexible, compressed DI conditioner.
ChimeyGuitar is a highly compressible instrument amp.
ChimeyGuitar2 is a wilder ChimeyGuitar.
Chorus is a mono chorus that also works as a vibrato.
ChorusEnsemble is a more complex, multi-tap mono chorus.
ChromeOxide is another path to vibey old tape sound.
Cider is a re-release of another old Character plugin.
ClearCoat is an array of bright ambience reverbs.
ClipOnly2 suppresses the brightness of digital clipping without affecting unclipped samples, at any sample rate.
ClipOnly3 is just plain, seriously loud.
ClipSoftly is ClipOnly2 as a soft clipper: a very handy building block.
CloudCoat is an array of blur effects with a taste for evil.
Coils models the types of distortion you find in transformers.
Coils2 is a transformer overdrive emulator.
Cojones is a new kind of distortion.
Compresaturator fades between compressing and soft clipping.
Console0Buss is a radical, minimalist Console system.
Console0Channel is a radical, minimalist Console system.
Console4Buss is the original Airwindows in-the-box mixing system, a two-plugin mix bus replacement for DAWs.
Console4Channel is the original Airwindows in-the-box mixing system, a two-plugin mix bus replacement for DAWs.
Console5Buss is a richer, warmer Console system.
Console5Channel is a richer, warmer Console system.
Console5DarkCh is a richer, warmer Console system.
Console6Buss is a newer, more intense Console that peaks at a lower level.
Console6Channel is a newer, more intense Console that peaks at a lower level.
Console7Buss adds anti-alias filtering and special saturation curves.
Console7Cascade is a drop-in replacement for Console7Channel that allows much higher gain.
Console7Channel adds anti-alias filtering and special saturation curves.
Console7Crunch is Console7Cascade with its EQ weighted for more edge and grit.
Console8BussHype swaps only the In section of Console8BussIn for a brighter, more sparkling circuit.
Console8BussIn moves to a channel, submix and bus topology and adds analog simulation.
Console8BussOut moves to a channel, submix and bus topology and adds analog simulation.
Console8ChannelHype swaps only the In section of Console8ChannelIn for a brighter, more sparkling circuit.
Console8ChannelIn moves to a channel, submix and bus topology and adds analog simulation.
Console8ChannelOut moves to a channel, submix and bus topology and adds analog simulation.
Console8LiteBuss is a simplified Console8 that works with just a single mix bus.
Console8LiteChannel is a simplified Console8 that works with just a single mix bus.
Console8SubHype swaps only the In section of Console8SubIn for a brighter, more sparkling circuit.
Console8SubIn moves to a channel, submix and bus topology and adds analog simulation.
Console8SubOut moves to a channel, submix and bus topology and adds analog simulation.
Console9Buss is just the summing from ConsoleX.
Console9Channel is just the summing from ConsoleX.
ConsoleLABuss is the Airwindows take on the Quad Eight console.
ConsoleLAChannel is the Airwindows take on the Quad Eight console.
ConsoleMCBuss is the first, bright take on the MCI console.
ConsoleMCChannel is the first, bright take on the MCI console.
ConsoleMDBuss goes for the tone shaping of the classic MCI console.
ConsoleMDChannel goes for the tone shaping of the classic MCI console.
CreamCoat is a Swiss Army knife reverb with soft undersampling.
Creature is a soft slew saturator, a new class of noise changer.
CrickBass is a flexible but aggressive bass tone for dual pickups.
CrunchCoat is a cursed retro digital reverb.
CrunchyGrooveWear is a version of GrooveWear with more edge and distortion.
Crystal is a tone shaper and bus soft clipper.
CStrip is an Airwindows channel strip.
CStrip2 refines and optimizes CStrip, by request.
curve is the simplest, purest form of Recurve, with no extra boosts.
DarkNoise is an alternative way to produce bassier noise directly, for sound design.
Dattorro is the resonant lowpass filter from Donut.
DeBess is an improved DeEss, with perfect rejection of non-ess audio.
DeBez gives you retro sampler textures.
Deckwrecka fattens and dirties up beats.
DeCrackle isolates clicks and vinyl crackle to remove them.
DeEss is a top de-essing solution and a go-to utility plugin.
DeHiss tries to suppress background hiss, like a hiss gate.
DeNoise can work as a multiband gate and as a wild effect.
Density is a Swiss Army knife of saturation and anti-saturation.
Density2 is a different color of Density, based on older code people asked for.
Density3 refines Density to keep up with recent developments.
DeRez is an analog-style bit and sample rate crusher with continuous adjustment.
DeRez2 brings more authentic retro-digital hardware tones.
DeRez3 reinvents retro digital tones.
DeRez4 perfects retro digital tones.
DeRez5 adds new forms of resolution reduction.
Desk is classic, subtle Airwindows analog modeling.
Desk4 is distinctive analog coloration, a tunable version of the control-less Desk plugins.
DigitalBlack is a quick, staccato gate.
Dirt is a soft-clip distortion in the spirit of Edge.
Discontapeity combines air modeling with tape-style overdrive.
Discontinuity models air under intense loudness.
Disintegrate is Discontinuity on steroids.
Distance makes sounds or reverbs seem far away.
Distance2 is a versatile space shaper for creating depth.
Distance3 combines the best parts of Distance and Discontinuity.
Distortion is a slightly dark, analog-style distortion with several modes, like Focus.
Donut is in memory of J Dilla.
Doublelay is StereoDoubler with independent delays and feedback.
Drive is the angry distortion.
DrumSlam is a heavy-processing tape modeler.
DubCenter is a version of DubSub where the bass reinforcement is purely mono.
Dubly is a retro vibe and atmosphere maker.
Dubly2 is a key part of seventies sound.
Dubly3 refines and transforms the Dubly sound.
DubPlate is ruthless dubplate mastering for electronic music.
DubPlate2 is like an in-the-box mastering house for electronic music.
DubSub is a fully featured bass doctor.
DubSub2 is the essence of the Airwindows head bump.
DustBunny is unpredictable, distorted noise, like dust stuck under your turntable needle.
Dynamics is a combined compressor and gate.
Dynamics2 is the compressor and gate for the newer Console plugins.
Dynamics3 morphs between vari-mu compressor and expander.
Dyno is a lot like Mojo, but for intensity instead of loudness.
Echojam is an echo effect that is secretly a reverb.
Edge is a seven-stage distortion with Hypersonic filtering and tone shaping controls.
EdIsDim is a mid/side conversion utility.
Elation is a re-release of another old Character plugin.
ElectroHat is a hi-hat tone generator that uses the original sound as a control voltage.
Elliptical highpasses the side channel.
Energy is electrifying fixed-frequency treble boosts.
Energy2 is electrifying fixed-frequency treble boosts for high sample rates.
Ensemble is a quirky, flanger-like little modulation effect.
EQ is just the EQ part of CStrip.
EveryConsole is mix-and-match Airwindows Console.
EverySlew is a wide variety of unique sound processing tools.
EveryTrim is left/right, mid/side and master trim in one plugin.
Exciter is an aural exciter that can be both subtle and extreme.
Facet is a new kind of hard clip that adds two sharp corners to the wave.
FastDistance is a kind of ultra-efficient lowpass filter.
FatEQ balances bands only with density.
FathomFive supplements extreme bass in a way that is not just EQ.
FinalClip is one stage of ADClip8, set up to clip at +6 dB for Final Cut Pro.
FireAmp is a bright, loud, tube-like amp sim for leads and dirty guitar.
Flipity is a channel phase flipper and swapper utility.
Floor is a fake bottom octave for fun and profit.
Flutter is the flutter from ToTape6, on its own.
Flutter2 is the flutter from ToTape7, on its own.
Focus brings out clarity by distorting. Aggressive, subtle, flexible.
Fracture is a frequency multiplier and waveshaper with a soft disruption to the sound.
Fracture2 is a wavefolder that allows more extreme disruption.
FromTape is a minimalist, cleaner analog tape emulation.
Galactic is a super-reverb designed especially for pads and space ambient.
Galactic2 is a super-reverb redesigned especially for pads and space ambient.
Galactic3 is exactly Galactic again, but with better undersampling.
GalacticVibe is the stereo vibrato from the original Galactic reverb.
Gatelope is a special gate that applies filters.
GlitchShifter is a gnarly, raw-sounding pitch shifter with a dose of insanity.
GoldenSlew is a multistage slew clipper based on the golden ratio.
Golem lets you blend a stereo track of two mics on an amp.
GrindAmp is a heavier amp sim for many purposes.
Gringer is a full-wave rectifier, like a Green Ringer guitar effect.
GrooveWear scrubs highs off mechanically, like a stylus would.
GuitarConditioner is like a Tube Screamer voicing without the squishiness and vagueness.
HardVacuum is tube-style saturation.
Hermepass is a mastering highpass to set by ear only.
HermeTrim makes very fine adjustments, otherwise just like EveryTrim.
HighImpact is distorted grit and punch without fatness.
Highpass is a time warp, for retro midrange sounds.
Highpass2 is an unusual-sounding variable-slope highpass filter.
HipCrush is the resolution reduction section of ConsoleH.
Holt is a synth-like resonant lowpass filter focused on bass frequencies.
Holt2 is a resonant lowpass filter that behaves like a bass cabinet.
Hombre adds atmosphere and texture through very short delays.
Huge is a dirty, dirty loudness maximizer.
Hull is an alternative form of highpass and lowpass filter.
Hull2 is a very clear three-band EQ.
Hype is a treble softening experiment gone strangely awry.
Hypersoft is a more extreme form of soft clipper.
Hypersonic is Ultrasonic, but steeper and with a higher cutoff.
HypersonX is like UltrasonX, but with seven stages instead of five.
Infinity is a MatrixVerb designed to sustain and layer sounds forever.
Infinity2 expands Infinity with more tone shaping and a much-requested kill switch.
Inflamer is an Airwindows take on the waveshapers in Oxford Inflator.
Infrasonic is a very steep subsonic filter, built like Ultrasonic.
Interstage is a subtle and sophisticated analogifier.
IronOxide5 is the old-school, heavily colored Airwindows tape emulation.
IronOxideClassic is the purer, simpler, early form of IronOxide before all the features.
IronOxideClassic2 is the band-pass-like tape sim, updated for high sample rates and aliasing control.
Isolator is a steep highpass or lowpass filter, like you might find in a speaker crossover.
Isolator2 is Isolator with control smoothing and a new resonance booster.
Isolator3 is Isolator2 on one slider, with a band-narrowing control.
kAlienSpaceship is an unreal, realistic reverb.
Kalman is not a real filter.
kBeyond is a recital hall.
kCathedral is a giant reverberant space.
kCathedral2 is a giant reverberant space modeled after the Bricasti Cathedral.
kCathedral3 is a giant cathedral-like space using Bezier undersampling.
kCathedral4 is the Cathedral sound expressed as distant space.
kCathedral5 lets you place yourself anywhere you like in the space.
kChamberAR is a take on tape echo into chamber echo.
kCosmos is infinite space ambient, or a titanic hall.
kCyberCity brings live atmosphere to deep reverb.
kGuitarHall accentuates loud midrange skronk.
kGuitarHall2 puts things in a loud room.
kPlate140 is a next-generation Airwindows plate reverb.
kPlate240 is for the texture of a smaller, gold foil plate reverb.
kPlateA is a plate reverb, not unlike its namesake atop Abbey Road.
kPlateB is a plate reverb, not unlike its namesake atop Abbey Road.
kPlateC is a plate reverb, not unlike its namesake atop Abbey Road.
kPlateD is a plate reverb, not unlike its namesake atop Abbey Road.
kRockstar is a realistic hall reverb that blends very well.
kRockstar2 is a realistic hall reverb using a new matrix.
kStation is a realistic small room modeled after David Bowie\'s vocal reverb.
kWoodRoom is a small wooden performance space.
LeadAmp is an amp sim with a clear, penetrating, vocal tone.
LeftoMono copies the left channel to both, losslessly.
LilAmp is a tiny amp sim, like a little practice amp without much gain.
Logical4 is a classic bus compressor.
Longhand is an experiment in soft clipping.
Loud is distortion and the demolition of air molecules, modeled.
Lowpass deepens the tone and leaves gloss and textural changes.
Lowpass2 is an unusual-sounding variable-slope lowpass filter.
LRConvolve multiplies each channel by the other.
LRConvolve2 multiplies each channel by the other, plus Soar.
LRConvolve3 gates one channel by the other, roughly or cleanly.
LRFlipTimer swaps left and right every few minutes (1 to 10).
Luxor is a re-release of another old Character plugin.
MackEQ is the Mackie distortion with treble and bass controls added.
Mackity is an emulation of the input stage of a vintage Mackie 1202.
Mastering is mastering, Airwindows style, and can do things nothing else can.
Mastering2 is mastering, Airwindows style, now with elliptical EQ.
MatrixVerb is a wildly adjustable, strangely colorful reverb for deep and flexible spaces.
Melt is a wobbly, chorus-like, weird diffuse effect.
MidAmp is a clean amp sim meant to work like a loud Twin or something of that nature.
MidSide is the other half of the EdIsDim mid/side conversion utility.
Mojo makes things bigger and also works as a loudness maximizer.
MoNoam gives you variations on mono, mid and side in different channels.
MSFlipTimer swaps stereo with mono every few minutes (1 to 10).
MultiBandDistortion is an old, weird, gnarly sound wrecker.
MV is a dual-mono reverb based on BitShiftGain and the old Midiverbs.
MV2 is a dual-mono reverb based on BitShiftGain and the old Midiverbs, adapted to high sample rates.
NCSeventeen is dirty loud.
Neverland is a re-release of the old Neve-style color adder, exactly as it was.
Nikola is an audio Tesla coil. Note: audio Tesla coils don\'t sound nice.
Noise is the Airwindows deep noise oscillator, as a sound reinforcer.
NonlinearSpace is a flexible reverb.
OneCornerClip is an ultimate full-bandwidth clipper.
OrbitKick is a bass generator and kick drum reinforcer.
Overheads compresses only part of the sound, in a strange way.
Pafnuty is a Chebyshev filter that adds harmonics.
Pafnuty2 is a Chebyshev filter that adds harmonics, in its newer form.
Parametric is three bands of ConsoleX EQ, released in advance.
PDBuss is Console5 and PurestDrive at once, on channels and bus.
PDChannel is Console5 and PurestDrive at once, on channels and bus.
Pear is the testbed for a new filter, implemented as a highpass and lowpass shelf.
Pear2 is the Pear filter plus nonlinearity.
PearEQ is a six-band graphic EQ based on Pear.
PearLiteEQ is a four-band graphic EQ based on Pear.
PhaseNudge is a phase rotator and allpass filter.
PitchDelay is TapeDelay2 with pitch shift instead of flutter.
PitchNasty is a primitive pitch shifter that also has primitive time-stretch artifacts.
PlatinumSlew is the best easy-to-use slew clipper.
PocketVerbs is the popular old special-effects reverb collection.
Pockey is 12-bit (and lower) lo-fi hip-hop in a plugin.
Pockey2 is more efficient, more intense lo-fi hip-hop in a plugin.
Podcast is a simpler pile of curve-style compressors with hard clipping.
PodcastDeluxe is a pile of curve-style compressors and phase rotators.
Point is an explosive transient designer.
PointyDeluxe devours all mix space.
PointyGuitar is a highly adaptable instrument amp.
Pop is a crazy overcompressor with a very exaggerated sound.
Pop2 adds control and punch to Pop.
Pop3 is the dynamics section from ConsoleX.
PowerSag emulates power supply limitations for analog modeling.
PowerSag2 is the improved circuit-starving plugin, now with an inverse effect.
Precious is a re-release of another old Character plugin.
Preponderant is Airwindows\' anti-Soothe, a strange tone intensifier and balancer.
Pressure4 is a compressor adjustable between vari-mu and \"New York\" peak-retaining behavior.
Pressure5 expands Pressure4 with after-boost and built-in ClipOnly2.
Pressure6 refines the Pressure compressor and how it moves.
PrimeFIR is a mostly linear-phase brickwall filter with a taste for the bizarre.
PunchyDeluxe is a smoother form of PointyDeluxe.
PunchyDeluxe2 is a more usable PunchyDeluxe.
PurestAir is a brightness experiment.
PurestConsole2Buss is the distributed filter version of PurestConsole.
PurestConsole2Channel is the distributed filter version of PurestConsole.
PurestConsole3Buss is an alternative algorithm for minimalist Console.
PurestConsole3Channel is an alternative algorithm for minimalist Console.
PurestConsoleBuss is the Console system most free from coloration.
PurestConsoleChannel is the Console system most free from coloration.
PurestDrive is the magic saturation plugin of subtlety and French house tone.
PurestDualPan is an updated PurestGain as a dual pan.
PurestEcho is optimized Airwindows echo with exactly four evenly spaced taps.
PurestFade is just like PurestGain, but for long fades.
PurestGain is a high-resolution, noise-shaped gain with a smoothed fader.
PurestSaturation is an experiment in soft clipping.
PurestSquish is an open-sounding compressor with bass bloom.
PurestWarm is a subtle tone shaper and warmth adder.
PurestWarm2 adds dual dry/wet controls for each side of the waveform.
PurestWarm3 is a subtle tone shaper and warmth adder.
Pyewacket is an old-school compressor for high-definition transients. Adds no fatness, just energy.
Recurve is a special bus compressor with no threshold point.
Remap puts the guts back into over-loudened audio.
ResEQ is a bank of mostly midrange resonances.
ResEQ2 is a single, sharp, sonorous mid peak.
RetroBass is a special kind of highpass.
Reverb is a simplified and tuned MatrixVerb that adjusts everything for each reverb size.
Righteous4 is a final output stage for targeting dynamic range.
RightoMono copies the right channel to both, losslessly.
RingModulator repitches sounds mathematically, not harmonically.
SampleDelay is three delays combined: milliseconds, samples and subsamples.
Shape is an asymmetrical waveshaper for manipulating peaks.
ShortBuss chases the second harmonic, to add or remove it.
SideDull is like Sidepass, but a lowpass on the side channel. Treble centerer.
Sidepass is a simple highpass on the side channel. Mono maker.
Silhouette replaces the sound with raw noise sculpted to match its dynamics.
Silken is a high-frequency boost that adds ambience and texture.
Sinew combines sines and slew clipping for a tape bias effect.
SingleEndedTriode is a set of unusual analog modeling effects.
Slew is a slew clipper that darkens treble in an unusual way.
Slew2 works like a de-esser or acceleration limiter: it controls extreme highs.
Slew3 is a new approach to slew clipping, meant for a more analog-like darkening effect.
Slew4 is tape compression without the tape, for brightness control.
SlewSonic combines SlewOnly with ultrasonic filtering to solo the brightness.
Smooth can tame pointy sounds or make drums explode.
SmoothEQ is a sharp, accurate, transparent three-band filter.
SmoothEQ2 is a wildly intuitive vibe EQ with clarity and intensity.
SmoothEQ3 is the most approachable EQ.
SoftGate is a gate that can mute hiss and smooth sample tails.
Spiral is the new best, smoothest distortion algorithm.
Spiral2 is Spiral with controls, including Presence.
SquareRoot has new discoveries in soft saturation.
Srsly is a psychoacoustic stereo processor.
Srsly2 revisits Srsly to make the stereo widening more extreme.
Srsly3 is Srsly2 with a Nonlin control to make the filters more analog.
StarChild is a weird digital ambience and echo plugin.
StarChild2 is a weird digital ambience and echo plugin, adapted to high sample rates.
StereoChorus is a nice, basic stereo chorus.
StereoDoubler is like GlitchShifter, optimized for pitch-shift doubling and tripling.
StereoEnsemble is a kind of hyperchorus blast from the past.
StereoFX is an aggressive stereo widener.
Stonefire is the non-EQ EQ designed for ConsoleX.
StoneFireComp is some of the dynamics from ConsoleX.
SubTight uses a variation of the Creature algorithm to tighten sub-lows.
Surge is a compressor for accentuating beats and pulses.
SurgeTide is a surge-and-flow dynamics plugin.
Suzan is a new type of ladder filter.
Sweeten is where you find super-clean second harmonic.
SweetWide is a strange, grungy stereo widener.
Swell is dial-an-attack, like sidechaining.
TakeCare is a lush chorus ensemble universe.
Tape is simplified, all-purpose tape mojo, a personal favorite.
TapeBias is a new part of ToTape that lets you underbias or overbias.
TapeDelay is an old-school tape echo with pitch swerve effects.
TapeDelay2 is a new implementation of a flexible tape echo.
TapeDust is a special treble-eroding noise, a \"slew noise\" plugin.
TapeFat is the tone control from TapeDelay.
TapeHack is a new dimension in tape realism, abstracted to software.
TapeHack2 brings Airwindows tape to a new level.
Texturize is a hidden-noise plugin for adding sonic texture to things.
TexturizeMS is a hidden-noise plugin for adding mid/side sonic texture to things.
Thunder is a compressor that keeps or exaggerates subsonic bass when you push it.
ToneSlant is a super-transparent tilt EQ with very low Q.
ToTape5 is Airwindows analog tape emulation.
ToTape6 is Airwindows tape emulation for 2020.
ToTape7 is Airwindows tape emulation with bias and Dubly.
ToTape8 is Airwindows tape emulation with gain staging, bias and optimized Dubly.
ToTape9 is Airwindows tape emulation and brightness compression.
ToVinyl4 is a vinyl mastering simulator with several vinyl-type colors.
TransDesk is transistor-style rock desk analog modeling.
Tremolo is fluctuating saturation curves for a tube-like tremolo.
TremoSquare is a square-wave tremolo that only switches at zero crossings.
Trianglizer is a special waveshaper that can turn sines into triangles.
TripleSpread is a stereo tripler with extra width and GlitchShifter processing.
Tube is a tube-style sound improver using a new algorithm for analog modeling.
Tube2 extends Tube with more sophisticated processing and an input trim.
TubeDesk is tone coloring like a tube recording console.
uLawDecode is a Console-like encode/decode pair, but much more extreme.
uLawEncode is a Console-like encode/decode pair, but much more extreme.
Ultralight is the lowest-CPU matrix reverb Airwindows could make.
Ultralight2 is more of the lowest-CPU matrix reverb Airwindows could make.
Ultrasonic is a very clean, plain, high-quality ultrasonic filter for use inside digital mixes.
UltrasonicLite is just one stage of ultrasonic filter, for use inside digital mixes.
UltrasonicMed is two stages of ultrasonic filter, for use inside digital mixes.
UltrasonX lets you build your own Console-type systems with total control over ultrasonic filtering.
UnBox is a distortion where only the harmonics that don\'t alias are allowed to distort.
VariMu is a more organic variation on Pressure (a compressor).
Verbity is a dual-mono reverb that uses a feedforward reverb topology.
Verbity2 adds stereo crossmodulation and expands Verbity\'s feedforward reverb topology.
VerbSevens is a calibrated reference reverb for reverb matrices.
VerbSixes is a calibrated reference reverb for Householder matrices.
VerbThic is a classic artificial reverb that is opaque and textured.
VerbTiny is a classic artificial reverb that expands the reverb shape.
Vibrato lets you vibrato, chorus, flange and make odd FM noises.
VoiceOfTheStarship is a deep noise tone source.
Weave is a fancy overdrive with a good texture.
Weight is a very accurate sub-bass boost based on Holt.
Wider is Airwindows stereo space shaping.
Wolfbot is an aggressive Kalman bandpass with evil in its heart.
WoodenBox is like a miniature reverb for turning DI into acoustic.
X2Buss is an updated version of the bus processing from ConsoleX2.
XBandpass is a distorted digital EQ, inspired by retro sampler DSP.
XHighpass is a distorted digital EQ, inspired by retro sampler DSP.
XLowpass is a distorted digital EQ, inspired by retro sampler DSP.
XNotch is a distorted digital EQ, less glitchy than the others.
XRegion is distorted, staggered bandpasses for extreme sound mangling.
YBandpass is texture-varying filtering, from soft and smooth to nasty and edgy.
YHighpass is texture-varying filtering, from soft and smooth to nasty and edgy.
YLowpass is texture-varying filtering, from soft and smooth to nasty and edgy.
YNotBandpass is texture-varying filtering, from soft and smooth to nasty and edgy, without control smoothing.
YNotch is texture-varying filtering, from soft and smooth to nasty and edgy.

ZRegion2 is an E-mu E6400-style Airwindows Region filter, with control smoothing.
